import pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, os
os.chdir("/tmp")
rows = [
 ("9841922","Brown 1998","interaction/biophysical","qualifies","mouse","CD48 binds 2B4 (Kd~16uM) > CD2; two counter-receptors"),
 ("16002700","Mathew 2005","mutational/interaction","qualifies(human)/competing","human","human 2B4/CD48 activates; states murine sends inhibitory signals"),
 ("17950006","Velikovsky 2007","structural","qualifies","mouse","crystal structure mouse 2B4-CD48 complex"),
 ("15123744","Lee 2004","mutant/blocking","refutes","mouse","2B4 ligation by CD48 inhibits NK lysis & IFN-g; 2B4-/- better clearance"),
 ("15356144","Mooney 2004","direct/isoform","refutes","mouse","CD48 on target inhibits; 2B4-long dominant; SAP-independent"),
 ("15870174","McNerney 2005","mutant in vivo","refutes","mouse","2B4-CD48 = MHC-I-independent NK self-tolerance (inhibitory)"),
 ("15634901","Vaidya 2005","knockout","refutes","mouse","WT reject CD48+ melanoma poorly; male 2B4-/- enhanced rejection"),
 ("16127454","Roncagalli 2005","adaptor mutant","refutes","mouse","EAT-2 & ERT inhibit NK function via 2B4"),
 ("17537992","Taniguchi 2007","mutant","qualifies","mouse","2B4-CD48 prevents NK fratricide; reframes 2B4-/- 'defects'"),
 ("27573813","Guo 2016","whole-locus KO (incl CD48)","refutes","mouse","Slam-locus deletion ENHANCES NK activation; inhibition solely 2B4"),
 ("20363967","Fortenbery 2010","mutant","refutes","mouse","2B4 dominant inhibitory; 2B4-/- restores cytolysis"),
 ("27249817","Claus/Watzl 2016","cis vs trans assay","qualifies/refutes","human","cis CD48 reduces trans signaling; disrupting cis enhances lysis"),
 ("27054584","Alari-Pahissa 2016","trans functional","supports(context)","mouse","CD48 on MHC-I-def targets contributes to NK activation (missing-self)"),
 ("20881194","Sinha 2010","direct + DKO","supports(context)","mouse","anti-CD48 induces NK IL-13; not mere disinhibition"),
 ("14666660","Johnson 2003","Ab agonism in vivo","supports(context)","mouse","anti-2B4/anti-CD48 crosslink reduces B16F10 metastasis"),
]
em = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["PMID","Study","EvidenceType","Stance","Organism","KeyFinding"])
em.to_csv("cd48_nk_evidence_matrix.csv", index=False)

mouse_func = em[(em.Organism=="mouse") & (~em.EvidenceType.isin(["structural","interaction/biophysical"]))].copy()
def dirn(s):
    if s.startswith("refutes"): return "Inhibitory (refutes seed)"
    if s.startswith("supports"): return "Activating-context (supports seed)"
    return "Qualifies/Neutral"
mouse_func["Direction"]=mouse_func.Stance.map(dirn)
tally = mouse_func.Direction.value_counts()
print("Mouse primary functional/genetic studies — direction tally:")
print(tally.to_string())
for d,g in mouse_func.groupby("Direction"):
    print(f"  {d}: {', '.join(g.PMID)}")

go_rows = [
 ("GO:0030101","BP","natural killer cell activation","FLAG (currently ISO)","Carry-over; seed 'promotes' direction REFUTED for mouse","15123744;15356144;27573813;16002700"),
 ("GO:0032815","BP","negative regulation of NK cell activation","candidate ADD","Best-supported mouse directional term","15123744;15870174;27573813;20363967"),
 ("GO:0045953","BP","negative regulation of NK cell mediated cytotoxicity","candidate ADD","Supported by inhibition-of-lysis assays","15123744;15356144;27249817"),
 ("GO:0048018","MF","receptor ligand activity","RETAIN (present ISO)","Correct informative MF for CD48 ligand","9841922;17950006"),
 ("GO:0009897","CC","external side of plasma membrane","RETAIN (IDA:MGI)","GPI-anchored surface ligand","UniProt"),
 ("GO:0045121","CC","membrane raft","RETAIN (ISS)","GPI-anchor partitions to rafts","UniProt"),
]
go = pd.DataFrame(go_rows, columns=["GO_ID","Aspect","Label","Action_lead","Rationale","Support_PMIDs"])
go.to_csv("cd48_go_decision_table.csv", index=False)
print("\nGO decision table:"); print(go.to_string(index=False))

plt.figure(figsize=(7,4))
colors={"Inhibitory (refutes seed)":"#c0392b","Activating-context (supports seed)":"#27ae60","Qualifies/Neutral":"#7f8c8d"}
tally.plot(kind="bar", color=[colors[i] for i in tally.index])
plt.ylabel("# mouse primary functional/genetic studies")
plt.title("Mouse CD48/2B4 -> NK activation: direction of evidence")
plt.xticks(rotation=12, ha="right"); plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("cd48_nk_direction_tally.png", dpi=130)
print("\nSaved CSVs + PNG in /tmp")
